metadata.title: SpaceX is officially worth more than Tesla, Meta and Walmart - MarketWatch

content.text:
1 day ago
SpaceX is officially worth more than Tesla, Meta and Walmart
SpaceX will instantly become one of the most valuable public entities on Friday when its stock begins trading.
The company on Thursday said it had raised $75 billion at a market valuation of more than $1.7 trillion, far more than nearly any other company in the world. It's also worth more than a few members of the “Magnificent Seven,” a group of valuable technology companies.
Tesla, also led by Elon Musk, is worth $1.43 trillion. Meta Platforms' market capitalization stands at $1.45 trillion, according to FactSet data. SpaceX is also worth more than Eli Lilly, Walmart and Micron Technology, which recently crossed the $1 trillion milestone, according to FactSet.
